patthana15.74:1.1: Saraṇaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo nasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.74:2.1: Araṇaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā naaraṇo naasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Araṇaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nasaraṇo naasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
patthana15.74:3.1: Araṇaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo naasaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
